name: Bible in a Year
summary: Read the whole Bible in a year with daily readings, catch-up days and a monthly benchmark your circle can cheer.

onboarding.prompt: When do you want to start?
onboarding.reaction: A fresh start date. Day one goes on your calendar.

onboarding.prompt: How many minutes a day can you give it?
onboarding.reaction: About 15 minutes covers a day's reading for most people.

onboarding.prompt: Which order do you want to read in?
options: Old and New Testament each day
onboarding.reaction: Good pick. We'll space the long books so no week feels heavy.

onboarding.prompt: Tap the time of day you'll read.
onboarding.reaction: Locked in. Your reading shows up there every day.

phases.name: Getting started
benchmarks: Read 4 weeks without missing two days in a row

phases.name: Steady middle
benchmarks: Monthly: on schedule or within one catch-up day

plan_blueprint.calendar: One daily event at the chosen slot; one catch-up block each Sunday.

approach_variants.habit: Attach reading to an existing daily habit (morning coffee); streaks shown.
approach_variants.willpower: Monthly challenge targets and a countdown to the finish.
approach_variants.time: Exact calendar block every day; weekly time-spent review.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen reward at each quarter milestone.
approach_variants.resource: First week sets up the Bible, app or audio version and a reading spot.

guardrails: Readings are a schedule; the person can change order, pace and translation at any time.
restart_rules: Missing a day moves that reading to the next Sunday catch-up; missing a week offers a re-plan that spreads the gap over the next month.
